items.title: Known limitation: account sign-in may fail
items.description: The external account provider may reject new sign-ins with HTTP 406 before password verification. Browser sign-in has been removed. Existing saved account data is preserved.

items.title: A redesigned Predator VPN
items.description: Purpose-built desktop and phone interfaces with clearer connection, account, location, and diagnostics controls.

items.title: Ten cohesive accent palettes
items.description: Orange remains the default; Gold and eight other color choices now apply throughout the interface, including the connection button.

items.title: More resilient proxy credentials
items.description: Authorization refresh uses single-flight requests, controlled backoff, and avoids repeated connection retries during temporary service errors.

items.title: Phone-first interface and Quick Settings tile
items.description: Touch-friendly bottom navigation, adaptive cards, and the newly supplied monochrome Quick Settings icon.

items.title: Existing accounts and settings preserved
items.description: Keeps prior app identifiers and secure saved credentials to support in-place upgrades.
